market_question: Will Neymar play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Neymar will be 34 by the 2026 World Cup and has suffered multiple serious injuries (ACL surgery in 2023, thigh issues in 2025) that make his long-term fitness uncertain. Brazil possesses a deep pool of attacking talent (Vinicius Jr, Rodrygo, Endrick) reducing reliance on an aging, injury-prone star; even if selected, he may not feature in a match. While Brazil's qualification is nearly certain, the probability Neymar both makes the squad and logs an appearance is closer to 65%, well below the market's 80.5% implied chance.
evidence_points: Neymar ruptured ACL/meniscus in Oct 2023, missed ~12 months, returned Oct 2024 but suffered another thigh injury in Mar 2025.
Brazil has strong attacking alternatives and current coach Dorival Junior may prioritize fitness/form over sentiment.
Age 34 with declining pace and recurring muscle problems increases chance of missing the tournament through injury or non-selection.
